hebrewText: אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהֹוִ֖ה תִּצְלָ֑ח הֲ/לוֹא֩ אֶת שָׁרָשֶׁ֨י/הָ יְנַתֵּ֜ק וְ/אֶת פִּרְיָ֣/הּ יְקוֹסֵ֣ס וְ/יָבֵ֗שׁ כָּל טַרְפֵּ֤י צִמְחָ/הּ֙ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְ/לֹֽא בִ/זְרֹ֤עַ גְּדוֹלָה֙ וּ/בְ/עַם רָ֔ב לְ/מַשְׂא֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖/הּ מִ/שָּׁרָשֶֽׁי/הָ

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
tokens.kjv: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

tokens.bdb: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
tokens.kjv: (my) Lord.

tokens.bdb: {YHWH}
tokens.kjv: God.

tokens.bdb: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
tokens.kjv: break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, -ously).

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a root (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bottom, deep, heel, root.

tokens.bdb: to tear off
tokens.kjv: break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.

tokens.bdb: fruit (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bough, (first-)fruit(-ful), reward.
tokens.explanation: peri — fruto, produto, resultado de algo

tokens.bdb: to lop off
tokens.kjv: cut off.

tokens.bdb: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
tokens.kjv: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food
tokens.kjv: leaf, meat, prey, spoil.

tokens.bdb: a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative
tokens.kjv: branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring(-ing).

tokens.kjv: arm, [phrase] help, mighty, power, shoulder, strength.

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)

tokens.explanation: rav — grande, muito, numeroso, abundante, ancião

tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.
